notes: Mass: the weighed subassembly total of the sheet (Misc. Avionics). CG: point masses placed by the rules of the settings (hub, half arm, origin). The origin mass is a stand-in position.

point_masses.source: Redback Master SpreadSheet - V2 Weight Breakdown.csv: Misc. Avionics weighed total (row 44) less the placed rows. Itemised in the rest: Cube Assembly, Avionics Battery, Here4, Herelink Module + fat antennas, ELRS Receiver + antenna, Stack Wiring, Ethernet Switch. Not weighed: M3 15mm Bolts. At the origin [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]: user rules of 2026-10-16: motors, propellers, ESCs and motor mounts are point masses at the hubs, boom arms half way along the arm, all other masses at the origin (stand-in: the real positions are not in the sheet)
